about: MesuKing insect and skill cards. Cards without x/y are bought, handed out by the Professor or earned in substories; `at` points to the place that gives them.

items.name: Giraffe Stag-Beetle
items.description: In the Coliseum lobby (counter area), on the floor between two red chairs.
items.notes: Only reachable once the Coliseum opens later in the story.

items.name: Hercules Beetle
items.description: Reward for Substory #78, Battle for the MesuKing Throne.

items.name: Empress Cicada
items.description: Inside Kyushu No. 1 Star in Pink Alley, between the bookshelf and the umbrella stand by the door.

items.name: Queen Alexandra Birdwing
items.description: Sold by the weapon vendor in Purgatory for ¥50,000.

items.name: Minminzemi Cicada
items.description: Sold at Ebisu Pawn.

items.name: Iwasakikusa Cicada
items.description: In front of the vending machines beside the lottery booth by Millennium Tower, next to the coin lockers.

items.name: Seven-spotted Ladybug
items.description: On the ground under the bicycles in the middle of Showa St.

items.name: Stag Beetle
items.description: In Serena's back lot, on the southwest side next to the building's fire exit.

items.name: Damselfly
items.description: On a tree in Public Park 3.

items.name: Japanese Giant Mantis
items.description: Reward for Substory #74, Time for a Raid! (you need at least 30 cards to take it on).

items.name: Miyama Stag Beetle
items.description: In the northeast corner of the back lot north of Tenkaichi Alley, beside the trash bins.

items.name: Paper Wasp
items.description: On the sidewalk in front of Club SEGA on Nakamichi St.

items.name: Sawtooth Stag Beetle
items.description: In the western part of Nakamichi Alley, next to a sign almost beside Smile Burger.

items.name: Honey Bee
items.description: On Pink St., south of SHINE: beside a trash pile under the pink "Wonderful Cafe" and Sweet Candy signs.

items.name: Japanese Rhino Beetle
items.description: Starter card: the Professor gives it to you at Club SEGA (Nakamichi St.) when you start playing MesuKing.

items.name: Old World Swallowtail
items.description: In the narrow gap just north of Cafe Alps, roughly across Nakamichi St. from Club SEGA.
items.notes: Stand in front of the gap and switch to first-person view (R3) to see it.

items.name: Western Hercules Beetle
items.description: Right next to the phone booth (save point) at the end of Senryo Ave.
items.notes: Guides call this the "eastern end" of Senryo Ave.; the marker uses the save point at the Showa St. end.

items.name: Small White
items.description: In the gutter a few steps southeast of the Kyushu No. 1 Star entrance.

items.name: Ashy Gray Ladybug
items.description: Win roughly 15-20 MesuKing battles at Club SEGA and the Professor hands it over.

items.name: Wasp King
items.description: Reward for Substory #76, The Professor's Past 2.

items.name: Autumn Darter
items.description: In the Champion District, in the tiny side street just north of Shellac.

items.name: Walking Flower Mantis
items.description: In the parking lot near the south exit of the Champion District, behind a car.

items.name: Atlas Moth
items.description: In front of the taxi at the east end of Park Blvd., by West Park.

items.name: Atlas Beetle
items.description: On Taihei Blvd. East, south of the Champion District, in the doorway of an unmarked building. Look for the red "Burning Sun" sign.

items.name: Orange Ladybug
items.description: In the passage leading to the empty lot southeast of the Champion District, beside a trash can.

items.name: Kawana's Ladybug
items.description: Inside Club SEGA on Nakamichi St., in the corner at the back.

items.name: Asian Giant Hornet
items.description: In front of the theater on Theater Square, beside a column in front of a movie poster.

items.name: White-tailed Skimmer
items.description: On Park Blvd., a little west of Vincent, in front of a love hotel.

items.name: Giant Petaltail
items.description: In Purgatory, inside the shed north of the fountain, in the corner of the awning.
items.notes: Switch to first-person view (R3) to see it.

items.name: Devil's Flower Mantis
items.description: In the entrance of Kanrai on Shichifuku St. East, behind the column on the right.

items.name: Cartwheel Kick
items.description: In front of a gate just west of the Hotel District taxi stand.

items.name: Face Masher
items.description: Starter card: the Professor gives it to you at Club SEGA (Nakamichi St.) when you start playing MesuKing.

items.name: Elbow Drop

items.name: Super Elbow Drop
items.description: Sold at Ebisu Pawn for ¥10,000.

items.name: Kestrel Punch

items.name: Super Kestrel Punch

items.name: Finish Breaker

items.name: Strangle Hold

items.name: Giant Swing

items.name: Super Giant Swing

items.name: Taunt
